core_problem_solved: To provide the full Neo4j graph database server as a single library, enabling it to be embedded directly within a Java application, typically for integration testing or highly specialized standalone applications.
key_features: An embedded, transactional graph database engine
Implementation of the property graph model
The Cypher query language engine for graph traversal and manipulation
era_and_niche: A server artifact for the world's leading graph database. Embedding the database was a common pattern for integration tests or all-in-one applications in the past.
reason_for_obsolescence: While Neo4j itself is a modern, leading database, the practice of embedding it via this artifact is now a **legacy approach**. The modern, recommended way to perform integration testing is with **Testcontainers**, which runs a real Neo4j instance in a Docker container. For standard applications to connect to a Neo4j server, they must use the official client driver: **`org.neo4j.driver:neo4j-java-driver`**.
